findingDetails.title: Default healer writes through symlinked packet documents
findingDetails.claim: The default healer accepts packet documents by name, reads them through their path, and writes changed text with fs.writeFileSync. A symlinked document can redirect an apply write outside its packet or repository; upgrade-legacy invokes this path with --apply.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Checked discovery, apply, and the upgrade caller. Other healer modes use atomic replacement; the default path has no lstat, symlink rejection, or canonical-path confinement before the direct write.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: The command is dry-run unless --apply is supplied, and writes only when a repair changes a document.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: Reject symlinked documents and prove an external symlink target remains unchanged during --apply.

findingDetails.title: Leaf walker follows a symlinked scope root outside the skill
findingDetails.claim: A declared scope that is a symlink to an external directory is followed by statSync; the walker reads that root before entry-level symlink checks and can emit external leaf paths as in-skill resources.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Absolute and parent-traversal scopes are rejected, and nested symlinks are realpath-confined. Those checks do not validate the starting directory; scope tests do not exercise an external symlink at the walk root.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: Generation records relative paths rather than contents, though consumers resolve those paths through the same symlink.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: Confine each canonical walk start to the real skill root and cover default and declared roots that point outside.

findingDetails.title: Archive destination symlink can move packets outside specs
findingDetails.claim: The source packet is confined beneath specs, but parent/z_archive is not resolved or checked before copy and source removal. A symlinked destination can redirect the packet copy outside specs.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Source canonicalization and symlink skipping in archive discovery were checked. The direct destination path has no canonical destination guard.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: Normal use has a real z_archive directory; the issue requires a symlinked destination and an archive operation.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: Resolve and confine the destination before copying or removing the source, with an outside-target symlink case.

findingDetails.title: Write token is available to dependency installation scripts
findingDetails.claim: The workflow grants contents:write, supplies checkout with a push token, and runs npm ci before generation and push. No credential-persistence override or credential removal precedes installation.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: The workflow uses pinned actions, a lockfile install, and push/workflow_dispatch triggers rather than pull_request. These reduce exposure but do not remove the credential during npm ci.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: The exact exposure depends on the pinned checkout action credential behavior and effective token scope.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: Verify the pinned action at its exact SHA and disable persistence or defer a narrowly scoped credential until push.

searchLedger.hypothesis: A packet document symlink can redirect a repair write outside its packet.

searchActions.queryOrPath: healDoc, discover, and apply write path
searchActions.result: The default path reads directly and applies changed text with fs.writeFileSync; no symlink or real-path guard is present.

searchLedger.rationale: The apply path follows a symlink when it writes the target document.

searchLedger.invariant: Every directory read must begin at a canonical path contained beneath the skill root.

searchActions.result: statSync follows a scope directory symlink; initial readdirSync precedes entry-level realpath confinement.

searchLedger.rationale: The starting root bypasses checks applied to nested symlink entries.

searchLedger.hypothesis: An unchecked archive destination symlink can redirect a copy before source removal.

searchActions.queryOrPath: archive_spec destination creation, copy, rename, and source removal
searchActions.result: The source is confined, but archive_root is used without canonical destination validation before mkdir, cp, mv, and rm.

searchLedger.rationale: A symlink at parent/z_archive redirects the destination while the canonical source remains eligible for removal.

searchLedger.hypothesis: Dependency install scripts can read a checkout credential with write scope.

searchActions.queryOrPath: workflow permissions, checkout token, install order, and persistence override
searchActions.result: contents:write and the checkout token are configured before npm ci; no persist-credentials:false override or prior credential removal is present.

searchLedger.rationale: The token is available during dependency installation.

searchLedger.hypothesis: A repository-provided remote or release value might be interpreted as a command or option.

searchActions.queryOrPath: execFileSync, git fetch argv construction, and option validation
searchActions.result: Git calls use argument arrays; leading-dash remotes are rejected and release values must parse as version tags.

searchLedger.rationale: The inspected path does not invoke a shell and rejects option-shaped remotes.
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: Argument arrays and explicit remote/release validation prevent the tested injection paths.

searchLedger.hypothesis: Compatibility steps or packet paths might be concatenated into a shell command.

searchActions.queryOrPath: compat command entries and integration-test invocation helpers
searchActions.result: The test reads commands from YAML and uses executable-plus-argv invocation; packet paths are positional arguments.

searchLedger.rationale: The reviewed command boundaries use argument arrays rather than shell interpolation.
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: No data-derived shell command was found in the compatibility invocation paths reviewed.

searchLedger.invariant: Gate metadata selects configuration and must not be evaluated as a command string.

searchActions.queryOrPath: pre-commit staged path handling and gate-config.tsv parser
searchActions.result: gates.tsv has hook/key/env/persistable/description columns; helper reads tab values and exports a quoted assignment; hygiene paths are NUL-delimited.

searchLedger.rationale: No eval or dynamic command column is used for gates.tsv; staged paths are quoted.
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: The inspected code does not execute gate metadata or interpolate staged names as shell source.

searchLedger.hypothesis: Pull-request-controlled context or packet/file names might enter a shell command unquoted.

searchActions.queryOrPath: workflow event expressions, permissions, packet capture, and validator calls
searchActions.result: Changed-packet validation uses commit SHAs and quotes packet arguments; both workflows grant contents:read.

searchLedger.rationale: Inspected values are fixed-format commit hashes or quoted paths; no shell evaluation or write token was found.
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: No direct shell interpolation of attacker-controlled names or writable token was found in these workflows.

searchLedger.hypothesis: Baseline selection and report paths might interpolate branch or packet data into shell source.

searchActions.queryOrPath: baseline download, branch/ref arguments, report handling, and permissions
searchActions.result: Branch, run ID, and report paths are quoted arguments; permissions are actions:read and contents:read. Report fields are printed in Node output, not passed to shell commands.

searchLedger.rationale: No shell command interpolation of packet names or report fields was found.
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: Workflow data is quoted or printed to logs; it is not evaluated as shell source.

searchLedger.hypothesis: Packet-derived folder or message text might contain newlines that become runner commands when printed.

searchActions.queryOrPath: strict-pass-freshness report fields written to Actions logs
searchActions.result: Folder and message fields are printed; the report producer was not traced, so attacker-controlled command-shaped newlines are not confirmed or excluded.

searchLedger.rationale: This log-parsing boundary is separate from shell interpolation and needs producer tracing before severity can be assigned.
searchLedger.deferredReason: Trace the report producer and determine whether packet-controlled newlines can reach Actions workflow-command parsing.
